item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya is studying for her Science test at home in Pune. She reads that Amoeba takes in food and oxygen from the water around it, and pushes out wastes, through a thin outer covering that decides what may enter or leave the cell. Which main cell part is being described?

options.A: Cytoplasm, because many life processes happen inside it.
options.B: Nucleus, because it controls the activities of the cell.
options.C: Cell membrane, because it separates the cell and allows useful materials in and wastes out.
options.D: Cell wall, because it gives shape and support to the cell.
